This announcement contains inside information for the purposes of the UK Market Abuse Regulations ('UK MAR'). Upon publication of this announcement, this inside information (as defined in UK MAR) is now considered to be in the public domain.
Cascade Surpasses 10,000 Sign-Ups in Under Five Months

Cascade Studio AI (AQSE: CASC), the AI-native production platform built for filmmakers, creators, agencies and brands, is pleased to announce that more than 10,000 people have signed up to its platform in less than five months since the launch of its open beta in June.

The milestone marks a significant achievement in Cascade's early growth, with its total sign-ups increasing from zero at the launch of the open beta on 17 June to more than 10,000 as at 10 November. The platform became fully live on 9 October, following the successful completion of its open beta phase.

The growth in sign-ups comes alongside the Company's ongoing customer acquisition and marketing activities, including its recently launched global Greenlight Film Competition, in partnership with BytePlus and Seedance, which aims to showcase the capabilities of Cascade, attract new users and convert participants into paying customers.

The Company has also simplified its pricing model, enabling users to purchase credits on a pay-as-you-generate basis without committing to a monthly license fee. New users are offered a time-limited free trial, after which they can choose between the pay-as-you-generate model and the existing Pro subscription offering. The changes are designed to make it easier for users to get started on the platform, while the Company remains focused on converting sign-ups into paying customers.

Commenting on the milestone, Simon Windsor, Chief Innovation Officer of Cascade Studio AI, said: “Surpassing 10,000 sign-ups in less than five months is a landmark moment for Cascade. It is particularly encouraging to have reached this milestone so early in our development and to see the community continuing to grow as more filmmakers and creators discover what Cascade can offer.

“Our ambition is to build the best-in-class filmmaking platform and make professional-grade production accessible to a much wider creative audience. The response so far gives us real confidence in what we’re creating, and our focus now is on growing the Cascade community. We’re excited to carry this momentum forward as we continue to develop and enhance the platform.”
Cairn Financial Advisers LLP - Aquis Corporate Adviser

Cascade is an all-in-one production platform built to scale professional-grade productions. It takes projects from first idea to finished film, series or micro-drama - in one place, with one subscription. Write the script, develop storyboards, create the assets, generate video and audio, and polish the final edit without switching between apps or losing the thread of a project.

Built by a multi-award-winning team with deep roots in filmmaking, VFX and virtual production, Cascade connects every stage of the creative process through a single environment. Proprietary AI and asset-management technology keep characters, worlds and creative decisions consistent from scene to scene - delivering the control and quality of a professional production, without the cost or complexity.
One platform. Every stage. Total creative control.
